# Part 11 · Prompt Injection

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dc8fESOxrk0/) · Published 6 Sep 2026

> Why is there no patch for prompt injection, and what do you build instead?

SQL injection was fixed with parameterised queries, because SQL has a grammar. A model reads the system prompt, the user's message and an attacker's sentence as one string.

![Whiteboard for Part 11](canvas.png)

## The three rules

1. Give the agent only the tools the task needs.
2. Ask a human before anything irreversible: send, delete, pay.
3. Never let untrusted content call a tool.
